description: Get recent SEC filings for a company by CIK number, ticker, or company name. Returns filing dates, form types, and accession numbers. Optionally filter by form type (e.g., "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K").

cik.description: Company CIK ("320193"), ticker ("AAPL"), or name ("Apple") — ticker/name are auto-resolved to a CIK

form_type.description: Filter by SEC form type (e.g., "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "DEF 14A"). Omit to return all recent filings.

name: get_company_filings
